messages.subject: Font Color
parts:
What's the best way change the font color as design time?  What's the best way to change it at run time?

For instance on this page (http://glimmer.rstudio.com/winston/heightweight/), how can I change the text "Height and weight of schoolchildren" or "Linear Model" to blue?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Font Color
parts:
There are several ways.

1) You can change the color using CSS. The "Height and weight of schoolchildren" happens to be an H1 tag, so you can include this <style> tag anywhere:

tags$style(type="text/css", "h1 { color: blue; }")

2) Another way to do it at design time is just to inline it.

headerPanel(HTML('<span style="color: blue">Height and weight of schoolchildren</span>'))

3) For changing it at runtime, you can use technique #2 in a reactiveUI/uiOutput pair, or the better way is to use CSS classes (use JavaScript to find the element you want, then add (or remove) a CSS class that you've defined to (or from) the element).
